entities.name: PMID:27499134
observations: In infant rhesus monkeys (7 iron-deficient, 7 iron-sufficient), CSF pyruvate/glutamine and phosphocreatine/creatine ratios were lower at 4 months, preceding group-level clinical anemia; PCr/Cr remained lower at 8 months after hemoglobin and MCV normalized.
At 4 months some iron-deficient infants already had low hemoglobin, so the result does not show metabolic changes preceding every hematological abnormality in every animal.

entities.name: CSF changes precede group anemia
observations: In infant rhesus monkeys, lower CSF pyruvate/glutamine and phosphocreatine/creatine at 4 months preceded clinical anemia across the iron-deficient group, although some animals already had hematological abnormalities.
